text: V1 is a RAS/MAPK paper-level transformer. Tokens are papers, not words. Time is causal. human_genetics and resistance are held out of inputs and of the loss. The probe label is prior_genetic_evidence: an earlier paper on the same gene timeline was tagged human_genetics. Compare a linear probe on frozen text embeddings versus contextual hidden states on years >= 2021. Then ablate that direction and see whether next-clinical prediction moves more when prior genetics is in context.
Claimed held-out genetics probe and ablation.
Claimed the causal paper transformer and trainer.

T1 src/ingest/pubmed.py: parse_europepmc_result(item)->dict keys pmid:str, date:YYYY-MM-DD, year:int, title, abstract, journal, mesh:list[str], pub_types:list[str]; fetch_papers(per_year=None)->list[dict] deduped by pmid (default config.PER_YEAR); main() writes config.PAPERS_PATH jsonl. Run: python -m src.ingest.pubmed. T2 src/claims/extract.py: enrich_paper(paper)->copy plus genes, drugs, diseases (schema vocabulary order), evidence_tags, relations. relations are {head, rel, tail} with rel in inhibits|activates|associated_with|resistant_to. inhibits and resistant_to: head=drug, tail=gene. activates: one pair, head=earlier GENES symbol, tail=later. associated_with: head=gene, tail=disease. main() reads PAPERS_PATH and writes ENRICHED_PATH. Run: python -m src.claims.extract. T3 src/encode/encoder.py: encode_texts(texts, prefer_neural=True)->float32 [N, 768] L2-normalized; module LAST_ENCODER. sentence-transformers is not imported at module import; it is imported only inside encode_texts when prefer_neural is True. The package is not installed, so that path catches the failure and falls back without raising. LAST_ENCODER stays config.HASH_ENCODER_NAME (hash768-v1) unless the neural model actually loads, then config.ENCODER_NAME (pritamdeka/S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO). main() encodes schema.paper_text (title+abstract) with prefer_neural=True, writes EMBEDDINGS_PATH float32 npy and EMBEDDING_META_PATH {encoder, n}. Row i matches enriched jsonl line i. Run: python -m src.encode.encoder. Model/probe: keep human_genetics, resistance, and evidence_tags off training inputs and the loss; they remain on the enriched records so the probe can build prior_genetic_evidence from earlier papers on the same gene timeline. genes/drugs/diseases are canonical vocab strings for multi_hot.

PaperTransformer.clinical_head is the Linear d_model->1 clinical projection; forward squeezes it to logits_clinical [B,T]. Checkpoint dict keys: state_dict, d_model, n_layers, n_heads, top_k (CPU state_dict at config.CHECKPOINT_PATH). build_windows items: pmid, year, date, text (float tensor 768), genes, drugs, diseases, clinical (1.0 if "clinical" in evidence_tags else 0.0), evidence_tags. collate_windows ignores evidence_tags; they stay out of the batch, along with every other FORBIDDEN_BATCH_KEYS entry. Forward also returns hidden [B,T,D], attn_index [B,H,T,K] (-1 unused), attn_weight [B,H,T,K] (0 unused), logits_genes, logits_drugs.

Report keys: encoder, n_papers, n_test_positions, prior_genetics_auroc_frozen, prior_genetics_auroc_contextual, prior_genetics_auroc_lift, resistance_auroc_contextual, ablation_delta_clinical_bce_genetics_context, ablation_delta_clinical_bce_no_genetics_context, selective_ablation, head_genetics_attention, notes. evidence_tags are read from build_windows window dicts, not from the training batch. Ablation uses batch y_clinical at the current position (collate already stores the next paper's clinical flag).

Integrated and ran the pipeline. 1958 Europe PMC papers, PubMedBERT embeddings, 8 epochs, loss 1.06 to 0.78. Held-out prior-genetics AUROC frozen 0.507 contextual 0.518. Ablation deltas 0.0024 vs 0.0017. No genetics circuit yet.
